name: hello_world
desc: Prints the NEORV32 logo and "Hello world! :)" over UART0, then halts.

name: demo_blink_led
desc: 8-bit binary counter on the GPIO LEDs, one step every 250 ms.

name: demo_clint
desc: Timer interrupt once per second: prints the time, toggles LED0, sleeps (wfi) in between.

name: game_of_life_64x20
desc: Conway's Game of Life on a 64x20 torus. Press a key in the terminal to start or pause.

name: bus_explorer
desc: Interactive bus console: type setup, press w, then write fffc0004 000000ff to set the LEDs.

name: benchmark
desc: CPU benchmark, 1 iteration (about 1.8 M cycles): list, matrix and state-machine kernels; prints cycles and iterations/MHz.
